title: Compose a Big Beat score with a rich drum-kit arrangement
description: Create and render a new Big Beat score whose sample hook is supported by a genuinely varied full drum-kit arrangement: distinct section patterns, fills, toms, cymbals, ghost notes, and no repeated template groove.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built Break Dance Engine with a fully written acoustic-kit arrangement: kick, snare, rim, ghost notes, closed/open hats, ride, toms, crashes, and unique four-bar break/fill phrases. Main audition measured objective_v2 103.94 with no v2 guards. Updated Big Beat skill to require section-specific real-kit writing when a kit is available.
